sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 6411.6 ± 62.5 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

literature_notes: Both ledger lines originate from the same paper (PMC12229354) and describe the same Myc-tagged ADORA1 construct. Neither quote specifies the insertion residue or junction; the supplementary table referenced in the paper is not reproduced in the ledger. The position (insert_after_residue = 0, N-terminal prepend) is the only extracellular terminal position available for a GPCR lacking a signal peptide and is therefore inferred rather than validated. ECL1 (69–81), ECL2 (147–179), and ECL3 (257–267) are also extracellular but the ledger provides no positional evidence for any of them; no sites in those loops are reported. If the supplementary table were available and named a specific residue, position_evidence could be upgraded to 'validated'.

literature_rejected.reason: residue mismatch: residue 0 is outside the sequence (1-326)
